scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && SERVE=false rollup -c && cp package.json dist/
scripts.build:win: rmdir /s /q dist && mkdir dist && set SERVE=false && rollup -c && copy package.json dist\
scripts.sandbox: npm run build && python3 harness/assemble.py && python3 -m http.server 8765
scripts.check: npm run lint && python3 scripts/check-words.py && node scripts/test-predict.mjs && npm run build
